question: Should Discord role mentions become explicit wake triggers, and should the contract be a configured role-ID list rather than all bot-held roles or the broader Discord access-list redesign?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds shipped Discord config surface and decides multi-agent role fan-out behavior in stable guild workflows.

options.title: Add explicit trigger roles
options.body: Add a narrow guild/channel trigger-role list that turns matching mentioned role IDs into wake mentions while keeping sender roles as access control.

options.title: Fold into access redesign
options.body: Keep this blocked until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/69748 defines broader Discord bypass, mention, and deny role semantics.

options.title: Decline role wake triggers
options.body: Keep direct bot mentions and @everyone/@here only, and document role mentions as non-wake metadata.

recommendation.title: Add explicit trigger roles
recommendation.body: Add a narrow guild/channel trigger-role list that turns matching mentioned role IDs into wake mentions while keeping sender roles as access control.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across Discord mention policy, preflight, and config routing for this surface.
